verdict.rationale: Airbyte Cloud's dbt Cloud integration explicitly triggers dbt transformations immediately following a sync, meaning dbt runs are event-driven on fresh data rather than a blind timer. This is documented specifically as post-sync triggering, matching the story precisely for Airbyte Cloud users. Missing for 10: equivalent documented support for self-hosted/OSS Airbyte (non-Cloud) triggering dbt runs, technical detail on the trigger mechanism (e.g., webhook vs polling), and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
